scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --mode admin
scripts.test: node scripts/test-node.mjs unit test/model.test.mjs test/api.test.mjs test/certificate-policy.test.mjs test/telemetry-policy.test.mjs test/config.test.mjs test/admin-session.test.mjs test/delivery-observability.test.mjs test/delivery-export.test.mjs test/delivery-v2.test.mjs test/browser-telemetry.test.mjs test/appearance.test.mjs test/rum-readiness.test.mjs test/spring.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rehearsal.json --project demo-chaicart --only firestore "node scripts/test-node.mjs integration --test-concurrency=1 test/integration.test.mjs test/outbox.test.mjs test/maintenance.test.mjs test/rate-limit.test.mjs"
scripts.test:api-auth: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rehearsal.json --project demo-chaicart --only auth,firestore "node scripts/test-node.mjs auth test/api-auth.test.mjs"
scripts.test:tooling-emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-chaicart --config test/firebase.tooling.json --only pubsub "node scripts/test-node.mjs tooling-pubsub test/tooling-pubsub.test.mjs"
